messages:
Ellen Park: Drafting a short, customer-friendly one-pager: prefill strategy, three ENG presets for batching, streaming safety-net, and a tiny renewal-signal to watch. Goal: pasteable for AE emails.
Harold Ng: Keep customer language simple. One line "what we do" + one copyable checklist and one ops snippet for ENG.
Ellen Park: Proposed opener for customers: 'Well prefill a representative sample of prompts, keep a small warm pool for critical flows, and switch to a fallback mode if streaming becomes unstable. We monitor a few simple metrics and will reach out proactively.'
Priya Patel: Add a short renewal micro-survey trigger: 'If weekly active sessions fall below 65% of expected by day 10, CS schedules a health check and a short 3-question survey.'
Harold Ng: ENG presets (copy these):
- latency-first: batch_window_ms=50, max_batch_tokens=512
- balanced: batch_window_ms=150, max_batch_tokens=2048
- cost-saver: batch_window_ms=300, max_batch_tokens=4096
Ellen Park: Customer pasteable prefill snippet (non-prod first):
```
# PREFILL (paste to infra notes)
prefill: true
sample_size: 150
mode: staggered  # immediate | staggered | steady
warm_pool_size: 5
warm_pool_ttl_hours: 72
```
Priya Patel: Signals to watch (customer-friendly labels + quick thresholds):
- Prefill success >= 90%
- Cache hit rate >= 60%
- p95 time-to-first-token < 800ms
- Stream disconnects < 10 per 10k
Harold Ng: Short escalation playbook (3 steps):
1) CS: collect 3 failing prompts, repro in non-prod.
2) ENG: check cache key schema, confirm model pin & quant variant.
3) ENG oncall: attach trace, enable temporary polling fallback.
Ellen Park: Small ENG curl to toggle fallback (internal use):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/admin/fallback \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"mode":"polling","interval_ms":500}'
```
Harold Ng: Tiny PromQL (p95 TTF, example):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
Priya Patel: Customer email two-liner to copy: 'Were priming your instance and will monitor performance for 72 hours. If you notice slowness or missing messages, reply with 2 example prompts and well investigate.'
Ellen Park: Action items: @Harold finalize presets and PromQL; @Priya add renewal micro-survey questions; Ill assemble the one-pager and add to CS playbook.
runbook-bot: New runbook created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cs/go-live-safety-net (access: customer-success, eng)
Priya Patel: small customer-facing fallback line to include: 'If streaming degrades, we may temporarily use polling to keep responses consistent while we investigate.'
Ellen Park: Nice. Publishing draft to CS drive by EOD. Drop any short snippets and Ill include. :white_check_mark:
